x_failures: Cites Tragus p.1014 for Pliny's 'phlegm of trees' (pituita arborum) and links Pliny to the thunderstorm-truffle idea, but that page says neither (the phrase is on the Theophrastus p.60 page). It also says Theophrastus wrote that fungi 'emerge after rain and can grow... upon the trunks of trees', which p.60 does not support.
reason: Every page-cited claim in Y checks out: Dioscorides' poplar bark (Cordier p.127), Pliny's silver vessels (p.160), Galen via Mattioli (Briganti p.95), Sterbeeck on Tuscany (p.65) and Micheli (Gleditsch p.11). X sends readers to the wrong page for its Pliny claims and stretches the Theophrastus page, though X does better at naming Theophrastus as the earliest source.
